'''Tarrah Hill''' was the highest physical point on [[Aquilaris Minor]], a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It was a high hill and became a rendezvous point for Aquilarian flood refugees during the [[Great Aquilaris Deluge]]. The refugees were led by [[Kerra Holt]] and were subsequently evacuated by [[Joad Kreel]] in a [[Seacropper Submersible]].
